title: changeEnvironment
responsibility: Lists automatic deployment destinations in order, stopping at preprod even when prod is selected.

inputs.name: changeEnvironment.environment
inputs.description: Selected environment; automatic promotion is limited to dev, stage and preprod.

outputs.name: changeEnvironment
outputs.description: Ordered lower destinations; prod selection returns dev, stage and preprod.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Rejects unsafe source, target or promotion state; no successful deployment receipt is recorded.
